title: Zealous Slovakian Millet Pilaf
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring millet, this yeasty and fluffy pilaf is a great hangover cure, made with katsuramuki-cut vegetables and paleo-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large pot, bring the water to a boil over high heat.
Add the millet to the pot, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the millet cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the katsuramuki-cut carrot and onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Once the millet is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the cooked vegetables, salt, black pepper, and yeast.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and serve hot.
Let the pilaf cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing.
